steps.en: The particulars check follows the electronic reminder or the driver's opt-out
steps.id: Pengecekan data mengikuti reminder elektronik atau opt-out driver
steps.why_en: The reminder and the data check run as separate scheduled processes; one does not wait for the other.
steps.why_id: Reminder dan pengecekan data berjalan sebagai proses terjadwal terpisah; yang satu tidak menunggu yang lain.

steps.en: Drivers due the 2nd letter are sent to the national registry for a data check
steps.id: Driver yang jatuh tempo surat ke-2 dikirim ke registri nasional untuk dicek

steps.en: The latest address from the registry is saved, and bad cases are put on hold
steps.id: Alamat terbaru dari registri disimpan, dan kasus bermasalah ditahan

steps.en: Foreign-ID drivers are checked through the government data platform
steps.id: Driver ber-ID asing dicek lewat platform data pemerintah
steps.why_en: That check is switched off in the production settings in the repo, and passport holders are never checked.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan itu dimatikan di pengaturan produksi di repo, dan pemegang passport tidak pernah dicek.

steps.en: Notices put on hold by the data check do not get the 2nd letter
steps.id: Notice yang ditahan oleh pengecekan data tidak menerima surat ke-2
